status: provisional; human comparability, wording, fairness and household-suitability review pending

initialResponse.anchor: Prioritize escape using the existing authored first-response decision; unsafe authored options earn zero

adaptation.anchor: Actual verified alternative movement after a committed failure of a previously verified path

communication.anchor: Use the recorded contact through an operational host-computed channel

continuity.anchor: Use the recorded positive stored water conservatively after supply loss; compare the two policies through isolated host projections

equipmentRequirement: No essential powered device or backup battery is needed for this plan. Do not add equipment or stock just to make an answer pass.
limitations: Supported route geometry, usable contact/channel and positive known water remain prerequisites for their respective anchors; unsupported situations remain unassessed in the fixed denominator. This is not universal household coverage or human-validated equivalence.
invariants: Retain all practice-phases/1 frozen-source, first-answer, save-before-feedback, no-reroll, latest-incomplete, offline/manual/accessibility and fixed-denominator protections. Sources share the same actual household/home/inventory; separate situations do not form one combined emergency.
